title: Invert Binary Tree
contract: Mirror a level-order binary tree by swapping left and right at every node. Return trimmed level-order values including internal nulls.
optimal: Tree root=tree(input);if(root==null)return new ArrayList<>();Deque<Tree> q=new ArrayDeque<>();q.add(root);while(!q.isEmpty()){Tree node=q.remove(),temp=node.left;node.left=node.right;node.right=temp;if(node.left!=null)q.add(node.left);if(node.right!=null)q.add(node.right);emit("Swap both child links","node",node.value,"tree",treeValues(root));}return treeValues(root);
reasoning: Build a separate mirrored copy, recursively placing the original right subtree on the new left.
Swapping child pointers at each existing node produces the same shape without allocating a second tree.
Both visit every node. The iterative in-place version uses frontier space; input construction and returned serialization are excluded from auxiliary-space comparisons.
complexity: O(n), O(n) extra tree plus O(h) stack
